assertions.name: detects_click_count_contradiction
assertions.description: Review detects contradiction between problem (reduce clicks) and solution (add more steps)
assertions.check: Output explicitly identifies that problem states 'reduce from 12 clicks to 5' but solution adds 15-step guide, 10 progress nodes, 12 stages, confirmation dialogs - increasing complexity

assertions.name: detects_simplification_vs_complexity_contradiction
assertions.description: Review detects contradiction between goal 'simplify' and solution 'add features'
assertions.check: Output notes that adding help buttons, step indicators, progress bars, confirmation dialogs contradicts simplification goal

assertions.name: uses_ask_user_question
assertions.description: Review uses AskUserQuestion tool to clarify contradictory points before final verdict
assertions.check: AskUserQuestion tool was invoked to ask about intended approach or clarify design intent

assertions.name: provides_alternative_approach
assertions.description: Review suggests alternative approach to achieve the goal
assertions.check: Recommendation section suggests concrete alternative (e.g., streamline existing steps, remove unnecessary confirmations, auto-advance simple steps)

assertions.name: verdict_blocked_or_needs_major_revision
assertions.description: Review gives verdict that design is blocked or needs major revision due to contradictions
assertions.check: Output states verdict as 'Blocked' or 'Needs Revision' with note about resolving contradictions first

assertions.name: explains_why_contradiction_matters
assertions.description: Review explains risk: implementing contradictory design will fail to achieve stated goal
assertions.check: Output explains that implementing this solution will increase clicks/complexity, opposite of stated goal, leading to implementation failure
